Name: Fadester for OBS
Description: Direct OBS source browsing, show/hide, scenes, transitions, mixer fades, and optional creative layer controls. Midi Fadester integration is optional.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-neo-.Name: OBS Scene Info Bar
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-neo-.Tooltip: Display OBS connection, live scene, and Studio Mode preview on the Stream Deck Neo Info Bar.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.layer-co.Name: Source & Layer
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.layer-co.Tooltip: Browse existing scene sources and show or hide the deck-selected source. Creative controls add blend modes and optional layer reordering.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Browse sources, blend modes, or explicitly enabled layer order
TriggerDescription.Push: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal
TriggerDescription.Touch: Show/hide source, or reset blend to Normal

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Name: OBS Fader
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Tooltip: Adjust an audio source, or blend the Live scene into Next with the colorful scene mixer.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust audio volume, or blend Live into Next
TriggerDescription.Push: Run the press action chosen in settings

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.scene-tr.Name: Scene & Transition
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.scene-tr.Tooltip: Select next or previous OBS scene, cut, preview, or run a chosen transition.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Name: OBS Fade
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-fade.Tooltip: Directly fade an OBS mixer input up or down without changing scene-transition settings.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.playlist.Name: Playlister Transport
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.playlist.Tooltip: Previous, next, play/pause, stop, restart or status of one Playlister source through OBS's media controls.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-filt.Name: OBS Filter
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.obs-filt.Tooltip: Ride a filter setting on a dial, or turn a filter on and off, set a value or step it from a key. Ranges, a gentle slew and ownership checks keep it safe.

TriggerDescription.Push: Drop and return, or turn the filter on and off

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.visual-p.Name: Visual Panic
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.visual-p.Tooltip: Visual Sidechain's Panic (instant) and Restore (hold 0.8 s), sent through OBS's own hotkeys. Panic keys show PANIC SENT until Restore.

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fader.Name: Midi Fadester Fader (optional)
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.fader.Tooltip: Optional enhanced control for an existing Midi Fadester slot.

TriggerDescription.Push: Run press action (hold 0.8 s for hold action)
TriggerDescription.Touch: Tap to jump or snap to side

com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.auto-fad.Name: Midi Fadester Auto-fade (optional)
com.jbrick2070.fadester-for-obs.auto-fad.Tooltip: Optional enhanced fade for an existing Midi Fadester slot.

pi.label: Label
pi.languageNote: Applies to all Fadester for OBS controls. Stream Deck's own menus, action list, tooltips and dial hints stay in Stream Deck's language. The two Midi Fadester settings pages follow in a later release.
pi.connHintOnce: Connect once for every Fadester button and dial.
pi.connAppliesAll: These settings apply to all Fadester controls on all your layouts. Enter the OBS password once here.
pi.connHintRejected: OBS rejected the saved shared password. Replace it once here for all Fadester controls.
pi.connHintSaved: Password saved for all Fadester buttons and dials. You do not need to enter it again.
pi.connHintShared: One OBS connection is shared by all Fadester buttons and dials.
pi.studioSetupNote: This control uses Studio Mode. Prepare Preview from your existing scenes to start mixing.
pi.layoutsIntro: Open an editable full, half, or creative desk. Scene buttons follow your current OBS scene list automatically. Main audio and microphone controls use matching OBS mixer inputs when available.
pi.layoutsInstallNote: The current starter installs as an editable profile once. Any older layouts you customized stay available.
pi.layoutOpenPrepare: Prepare Preview & open current starter layout
pi.layoutOpenEnable: Enable Studio Mode & open current starter layout
pi.layoutsOrderNote: Everyday Source Desks keep layer order fixed. Creative Layer Lab enables its labelled reorder controls.
pi.setupDone: Request completed. Accept the Stream Deck import prompt if one appears.
pi.optionalNote: You do not need Midi Fadester, an APC40, or any MIDI controller for the controls above. The separately labelled {actions} actions keep advanced shared slots and A/B layer mixing for people who use that setup.
pi.infobarNote: Shows the live scene and, in Studio Mode, the preview scene. The Info Bar is display-only.
pi.fadeIntro: Starts with Main audio from your current OBS mixer. Choose a fixed input to keep this button assigned to it.
pi.fadeInstantNote: 0 ms is instant. Any new volume move cancels a running fade for that input.
pi.fadeInputUnavailable: This audio input is unavailable in OBS. Choose another mixer input above.
pi.fadeChooseToFade: Choose an OBS mixer input to fade.
pi.sceneIntro: Previous, Next, and Random work with every scene in your current OBS collection. Automatic Scene 1/2/3 follows the OBS scene-list order, including renamed or reordered scenes.
pi.sceneHint: Cut and Transition work in regular and Studio Mode. Preview and Current Preview need Studio Mode. A chosen transition applies to this press and preserves the scene’s saved transition override.
pi.sceneBannerChoose: Choose Next, Previous, Random, an automatic numbered scene, or a fixed scene.
pi.sceneBannerStudio: Enable Studio Mode below to prepare this control and Preview.
pi.sceneBannerIndexOne: Scene {n} is not available. Your current OBS collection has {count} scene. Next, Previous, and Random use the whole available list.
pi.sceneBannerIndexMany: Scene {n} is not available. Your current OBS collection has {count} scenes. Next, Previous, and Random use the whole available list.
pi.faderIntro: Starts with Main audio from your current OBS mixer. Choose an automatic target or a fixed input to customize this dial.
pi.tbarHintPress: Turn to move from LIVE to NEXT. NEXT is the scene in OBS Preview. {press} This manual transition control (T-bar) needs Studio Mode.
pi.sceneLoopHint: Queue the next scene after each transition
pi.sceneLoopNote: After your fade finishes, the following scene in the OBS scene list becomes NEXT. Wraps to the first scene at the end. You still control every fade with the dial.
pi.pressNextBlend: Next blend mode on selected source
pi.pressPreviousBlend: Previous blend mode on selected source
pi.pressNormalBlend: Reset selected source to Normal blend
pi.pressCombined: Next blend mode, then take Next live
pi.displayNameNote: Optional text on this dial. Scene names always come from OBS.
pi.instrNextBlend: Press for the selected source’s next blend mode.
pi.instrPreviousBlend: Press for the selected source’s previous blend mode.
pi.instrNormalBlend: Press to reset the selected source to Normal blend.
pi.instrToggle: Press to show or hide the selected source.
pi.instrCombined: Press to change the selected source’s blend mode, then take NEXT live.
pi.pressSceneHintPreview: Preview scene: {scene}. Source selection is shared across the deck until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. A separate Source & Layer action can be saved with a fixed source.
pi.pressSceneHintLive: Live scene: {scene}. Source selection is shared across the deck until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. A separate Source & Layer action can be saved with a fixed source.
pi.pressSceneHintCombined: Blend + take changes this source first, then takes Next live.
pi.faderBannerStudio: Turn on OBS Studio Mode to blend Live into Next. For a single-scene setup, use Source & Layer.
pi.faderBannerSame: Live and Next are the same scene. Choose a different scene in OBS Preview to blend between them.
pi.faderBannerChoose: Choose what this dial should control.
pi.layerIntro: Browse the sources already in your scene. The deck shares one selected source per scene until the plugin restarts or the scene collection changes. Browsing keeps your layer order unchanged.
pi.scopeAuto: Follow Preview in Studio Mode, Live otherwise
pi.dialBrowse: Browse sources · press to show / hide
pi.dialBlend: Cycle blend modes · press for Normal
pi.dialOrder: Reorder layers · press to show / hide
pi.actSelected: The source selected on the deck
pi.fixedNote: To save a source on a control across restarts, choose a non-browsing action and select A fixed source above.
pi.reorderHint: Allow this control to change layer order
pi.liveNote: Layer edits change scene content immediately. Even in Studio Mode, editing a scene also on Program changes the live output. Blend modes are discrete choices, not a smooth crossfade.
pi.groupsNote: Lists show top-level sources and groups; a group is controlled as one layer.
pi.layerStatusSavedMissing: Saved source unavailable. Choose a fixed source above to change this binding.
pi.layerStatusChooseDeck: Choose a source with the deck’s source browsing controls.
pi.layerStatusNoSources: No sources in {scene}. Add a source in OBS.
pi.mfFaderIntro: This is the advanced shared-slot integration. For normal OBS mixer and Scene T-bar control, choose {action} instead.
pi.mfAutoIntro: This is the advanced shared-slot integration. For a normal OBS mixer-input fade, choose {action} instead.
pi.cleanAllFxNeeds: Clean All FX — needs Midi Fadester 0.4.0+
pi.thumbnailsHint: 96×54 in Mix two layers cells (1–2 FPS)
pi.durationHint: 0 ms = instant. A T-bar return to 0 % cancels the throw. 50–20000 ms = timed fade following the slot's curve.
pi.durationHintAllFx: All FX: resets enabled filter bindings in either bank to 0 %. Audio and layer controls stay unchanged. 0 ms = instant; 50–20000 ms = timed ramp.
pi.noReply: No reply from the plugin after 6 s.
pi.assignDraft: Unsaved changes. Apply in OBS when ready.
pi.assignIntro: Changes apply in Midi Fadester for the APC40, Stream Deck and every other surface. Pickers list only what the live OBS catalog offers.
pi.profileIntro: Loading a profile resets slot defaults in Midi Fadester for every surface. Only the active profile reports what the connected desk can do; this list is the API contract’s known profiles. Only APC40 mkII is verified on real hardware.
pi.downloadMf: Download Midi Fadester for OBS Studio 33
pi.connIntroMf: Connect once for every Fadester button and dial, including the direct OBS actions.
pi.passwordPlaceholderAuthOff: Leave blank if authentication is off
pi.passwordPlaceholderSavedAll: Saved for all Fadester controls (leave blank to keep)
pi.groupOffline: {group} (offline: contract defaults, connect OBS for live names)
pi.allFxClean: All FX — Clean / All FX Off
pi.ctrlOffline: Controller state is reported by Midi Fadester once OBS is connected.
pi.midiNotFound: MIDI: {device} not found. Plug it in, then reconnect in OBS.
pi.midiNone: MIDI: no device configured in Midi Fadester
pi.passwordSavedAll: Password saved for all Fadester buttons and dials.
pi.allFxSentence: All FX: cleans enabled filter bindings in either bank. Audio and layer controls stay unchanged.
pi.assignConnect: Connect OBS to see and change what this slot does.
pi.slotNotReported: Slot '{slot}' is not reported by Midi Fadester.
pi.enabledHint: keeps this slot's assignment when turned off
pi.catalogLoading: Loading the OBS catalog… (press Refresh lists if this stays)
pi.catalogNeedsMf: Midi Fadester 0.4.0+ lists scenes, layers and sources here. Until then, type exact OBS names.
pi.unassignedNote: The slot will do nothing until it is set up again.
pi.tbarOn: Fades Program to Preview like OBS’s T-bar. Nothing to pick.
pi.tbarOff: Studio Mode is off. Turn it on in OBS (View > Studio Mode) for this to work.
pi.bypassHint: disables the filter when the fader is fully down
pi.rangeHint: {label}: {min} to {max}. Blank bounds keep the existing range, or use defaults for a new binding.
pi.rangeHintSuffix: {label}: {min} to {max} {suffix}. Blank bounds keep the existing range, or use defaults for a new binding.
pi.noFilterList: OBS did not return a filter list.
pi.noChanges: There are no changes to apply.
pi.finiteNumber: Enter a finite number for every range or calibration bound.
pi.calibrationWhole: Calibration bounds must be nonnegative whole numbers.
pi.calibrationOrder: Calibration maximum must be greater than minimum.
pi.validLayersDiffer: Left and Right must be different layers.
pi.assignConflict: This slot's assignment changed on another surface. Discard edits to load the current assignment before applying.
pi.profileLoaded: Loaded {name}. Slot defaults were reset in Midi Fadester.
pi.connChanged: The OBS connection changed. Your edits are kept; review the refreshed source lists before applying.
pi.plIntro: Drives one Playlister source through OBS’s own media controls. Choose it by name; the key follows it through renames.
pi.plBannerChoose: Choose a Playlister source to control.
pi.plBannerNone: No Playlister source in OBS. Add one to a scene first.
pi.plBannerMissing: The chosen Playlister is not in OBS now: it was removed, or it is in another scene collection. Choose a Playlister.
pi.plBannerWrongKind: The chosen source is not a Playlister. Choose a Playlister source.
pi.plBannerUnsupported: This OBS WebSocket does not offer the media requests (GetMediaInputStatus, TriggerMediaInputAction). Update OBS.
pi.plNote: Status only shows the state. Play / pause toggles from the observed state. Stop first drops the Playlister’s unsent presses. Nothing is sent while the Playlister is unavailable.
pi.fxIntro: Rides one filter setting on a dial, or turns a filter on and off, sets or steps a value from a key. Choose the source and its filter by name; the control follows the source through renames.
pi.fxOpToggle: Turn the filter on or off
pi.fxOpSet: Set a value over a time
pi.fxPressToggle: Turn the filter on or off
pi.fxNote: A write moves at most a tenth of the range, never a setting an Audio Modulator or a fader drives, and nothing of a Visual Sidechain filter while Panic is latched.
pi.fxBannerChooseSource: Choose the source that holds the filter.
pi.fxBannerSourceMissing: The chosen source is not in OBS now.
pi.fxBannerChooseFilter: Choose one of the source's filters.
pi.fxBannerFilterMissing: No filter of that name on the source now. A renamed filter must be chosen again.
pi.fxBannerKind: This filter is now of another kind. Choose it again to control it.
pi.fxBannerDriven: {filter} drives this setting, so the deck never writes it. Unbind it there first.
pi.fxBannerRange: This setting is not in the deck's range table: type the range it may move in.
pi.vpIntro: Sends Visual Sidechain's own Panic or Restore through OBS's hotkeys; OBS does not need to be in front.
pi.vpNote: Every Panic press is sent. Panic keys show PANIC SENT until a Restore is accepted or OBS reconnects; meanwhile no Visual Sidechain filter is written from the deck. A Restore with no Panic before it changes nothing.
pi.fxBannerRangeChoose: Choose the range this amount may move in.
pi.fxBannerOutOfRange: OBS holds {value}, outside this range: the control does not move it until the value or the range changes.
pi.fxNoteOffTable: Any other number setting, a shader's own uniforms included, can be ridden once you type its range; choose it with care. OBS does not tell the deck which uniforms are lists: those named …_mode or marked as a list in the shader text are left out, any other you check yourself.
